svg.title: Four Core Seats; Two Additions at Scale
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-four-person-pod-six-person-scale; chart type: org_architecture; title: Four Core Seats; Two Additions at Scale; subtitle: Conservative and Base use 1 FT + 3 C; Scaled uses 2 FT + 4 C; chapter number: 11; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: FT denotes a full-time operator and C denotes a contracted seat. The first four seats form the four-person pod; the last two activate only in the six-person Scaled scenario. Specialist reports are purchased services, not additional standing pod seats.; caption: Keep signing authority and cash exposure with the principal. Automate evidence assembly and recurring billing, while retaining human review of rights and exceptions.; stages: label: Principal and acquisition lead; value: Core seat 1; full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own pricing, capital commitments, counterparty selection, and final execution. Approve acquisition assumptions against written demand and review the operator-revenue bridge before signing.; label: Rights and transaction counsel; value: Core seat 2; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review licensed-activity questions, title exceptions, assignment language, lender consent, and SNDA terms. Maintain a document checklist tied to each parcel.; label: GIS and site diligence coordinator; value: Core seat 3; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain QGIS parcel screening and coordinate surveys, environmental professionals, zoning confirmation, and DOT permit checks without substituting desktop screening for required field work.; label: Billing and transaction operations; value: Core seat 4; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile settlement statements, tenant invoices, master-rent schedules, insurance evidence, and access permissions. Escalate collection exceptions rather than automatically changing contractual rights.; label: Portfolio operating lead; value: Scaled addition; second full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take daily responsibility for active yards, renewal calendars, tenant exceptions, and vendor performance so the principal can maintain acquisition discipline.; label: Dedicated sourcing coordinator; value: Scaled addition; fourth contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Expand owner contact coverage and buyer matching using approved transaction roles and compensation structures. Preserve parcel-level attribution and prevent duplicate acquisition outreach.

text.title: Four Core Seats; Two Additions at Scale
text.tspan: Four Core Seats; Two Additions at Scale

rect.title: label: Principal and acquisition lead; value: Core seat 1; full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Own pricing, capital commitments, counterparty selection, and final execution. Approve acquisition assumptions against written demand and review the operator-revenue bridge before signing.

text.title: Own pricing, capital commitments, counterparty selection, and final execution. Approve acquisition assumptions against written demand and review the operator-revenue bridge before signing.

rect.title: label: Rights and transaction counsel; value: Core seat 2; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Review licensed-activity questions, title exceptions, assignment language, lender consent, and SNDA terms. Maintain a document checklist tied to each parcel.

text.title: Review licensed-activity questions, title exceptions, assignment language, lender consent, and SNDA terms. Maintain a document checklist tied to each parcel.

rect.title: label: GIS and site diligence coordinator; value: Core seat 3; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Maintain QGIS parcel screening and coordinate surveys, environmental professionals, zoning confirmation, and DOT permit checks without substituting desktop screening for required field work.

text.title: Maintain QGIS parcel screening and coordinate surveys, environmental professionals, zoning confirmation, and DOT permit checks without substituting desktop screening for required field work.

rect.title: label: Billing and transaction operations; value: Core seat 4; contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Reconcile settlement statements, tenant invoices, master-rent schedules, insurance evidence, and access permissions. Escalate collection exceptions rather than automatically changing contractual rights.

text.title: Reconcile settlement statements, tenant invoices, master-rent schedules, insurance evidence, and access permissions. Escalate collection exceptions rather than automatically changing contractual rights.

rect.title: label: Portfolio operating lead; value: Scaled addition; second full-time operator; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Take daily responsibility for active yards, renewal calendars, tenant exceptions, and vendor performance so the principal can maintain acquisition discipline.

text.title: Take daily responsibility for active yards, renewal calendars, tenant exceptions, and vendor performance so the principal can maintain acquisition discipline.

rect.title: label: Dedicated sourcing coordinator; value: Scaled addition; fourth contracted specialist; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Expand owner contact coverage and buyer matching using approved transaction roles and compensation structures. Preserve parcel-level attribution and prevent duplicate acquisition outreach.

text.title: Expand owner contact coverage and buyer matching using approved transaction roles and compensation structures. Preserve parcel-level attribution and prevent duplicate acquisition outreach.

Assumptions: FT denotes a full-time operator and C denotes a contracted seat. The first four seats form the four-person pod; the last two activate only in the six-person Scaled scenario. Specialist reports are purchased services, not additional standing pod seats.
